`khive-node-v1 vector recipient kem`, `khive-node-v1 vector sender sig`,
`khive-node-v1 vector recipient sig` and `khive-node-v1 vector ephemeral`

the nonce is the first 16
bytes of `SHA-256("khive-node-v1 vector nonce")`.

conformance_cases.case: a delivery under a genuine binding whose envelope does not open
conformance_cases.required_outcome: no receipt, no replay identity; a later authentic delivery of the same logical message is stored

conformance_cases.case: a delivery from a sender key epoch the owner has not confirmed
conformance_cases.required_outcome: held unopened, no receipt, until the owner confirms

conformance_cases.case: a receipt whose signature is valid but whose binding names another logical message or another sender
conformance_cases.required_outcome: the sender's message stays `pending`

conformance_cases.case: a receipt signed with a key the service supplies rather than the pinned one
conformance_cases.required_outcome: the sender's message stays `pending`

conformance_cases.case: a submit repeated after its answer was lost, the recipient having since revoked the grant
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `200` with the recorded receipt

conformance_cases.case: a submit of a logical message already admitted to another recipient
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `envelope_conflict`

conformance_cases.case: a plaintext carrying a `from` member, or a duplicated member
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `quarantined` receipt, no message note

conformance_cases.case: a plaintext whose `kind` is `null`, `reply` or any value other than `announce`, `report` and `ask`
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `quarantined` receipt, no message note

conformance_cases.case: a plaintext with `kind` `announce` that the recipient's pair policy admits
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `stored` receipt, and the message note records the kind

conformance_cases.case: a valid plaintext the recipient's pair policy refuses under `enforce`
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `quarantined` receipt, the item in local quarantine with its parsed plaintext, no message note

conformance_cases.case: a delivery arriving while the recipient's policy store cannot be read
conformance_cases.required_outcome: no commit, no receipt; once the store reads again, the next arrival of the message is stored and receipted exactly once

conformance_cases.case: a logical message stored, its receipt dropped after `not_found`, delivered again under a new attempt after the recipient's policy changed to refuse it
conformance_cases.required_outcome: no quarantine item; the journal entry for the new attempt carries `stored`

conformance_cases.case: a pending message the sender's pair policy refuses under `enforce` before a submission
conformance_cases.required_outcome: no submission; `pending` with the hold reason `policy_denied`; while held, no retry and no status-read resubmission; a later evaluation that admits it submits it

conformance_cases.case: a message answered `202`, then refused by the sender's pair policy at its resubmission, whose earlier admission the recipient stores
conformance_cases.required_outcome: no resubmission; the verified receipt from the next poll moves it to `recipient_stored`; shown as charged throughout

conformance_cases.case: a policy revision that admits the pair, published after the refusing evaluation and before its hold is written (a runtime test with a seam at that point)
conformance_cases.required_outcome: the message is evaluated under the new revision and submitted

conformance_cases.case: messages held for `policy_denied` under `enforce` when the mode moves to `off` or `shadow`
conformance_cases.required_outcome: submitted, with no revision change

conformance_cases.case: a pending message whose next submission finds the sender's policy store unreadable
conformance_cases.required_outcome: no submission, no hold; once the store reads again, the next backoff step evaluates it and, if admitted, submits it, with no revision change

conformance_cases.case: a message held because its recipient's class was changed, the class then restored with no rule edited
conformance_cases.required_outcome: evaluated again and submitted

conformance_cases.case: a verified receipt recorded between a refusing evaluation and its hold write (a runtime test with a seam at that point)
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `recipient_stored`, no hold

conformance_cases.case: a held message refused again at a re-evaluation
conformance_cases.required_outcome: no further evaluation until the state differs again

conformance_cases.case: a held message whose re-evaluation cannot read the sender's policy store
conformance_cases.required_outcome: leaves the hold; no submission until the store reads, then retried on the backoff

conformance_cases.case: a plaintext declaring `ask` whose `in_reply_to` names the sender's own earlier message, which the recipient stored, under a recipient policy that allows `reply` and denies `ask`
conformance_cases.required_outcome: evaluated as `ask`: `quarantined` receipt

conformance_cases.case: a plaintext declaring `ask` whose `in_reply_to` names a message the recipient sent to this sender, under the same policy
conformance_cases.required_outcome: evaluated as a reply: `stored` receipt, the note records `reply`

conformance_cases.case: a plaintext declaring `ask` whose `in_reply_to` names a message another agent of the recipient's deployment sent to this sender, under the same policy
conformance_cases.required_outcome: not a reply: evaluated as `ask`, `quarantined` receipt

conformance_cases.case: a valid plaintext the recipient's pair policy refuses under `shadow`
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `stored` receipt, the would-be refusal audited, no quarantine item

conformance_cases.case: a valid plaintext under `off` whose pair the recipient's rules would refuse
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `stored` receipt, nothing evaluated

conformance_cases.case: two arrivals of one logical message in step 4 at once, the recipient's policy changing between their evaluations
conformance_cases.required_outcome: one commit, one disposition, and both journal entries carry it

conformance_cases.case: a request body with an unknown member
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `400 invalid_request`

conformance_cases.case: a delivery whose recipient key epoch was replaced after admission
conformance_cases.required_outcome: released, never handed out

conformance_cases.case: a correctly signed request, arriving inside the step 4 window, whose timestamp is before the nonce-memory floor: signed before a relay restart and held in transit or re-sent unchanged, or signed after it by a clock running behind
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `503 capacity_exhausted` with `retry_after_seconds` 60, no effect; the client re-signs, retries, and does not pause the channel

conformance_cases.case: a replay, after a restart, of a request the service accepted before it, from a client whose clock ran up to 59 seconds ahead
conformance_cases.required_outcome: refused (`503` at step 6, or `401` at step 4 once it is older than 300 seconds), no effect

conformance_cases.case: a request from a client with an accurate clock, signed less than 60 seconds after nonce memory started at a relay restart
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `503 capacity_exhausted` with `retry_after_seconds` 60, no effect; the same client's re-signed retry 61 seconds or more after nonce memory started, plus twice the clock bound where one applies, is served normally

conformance_cases.case: a request whose timestamp is 60 seconds or more ahead of the service's clock
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `401 unauthenticated`

conformance_cases.case: a directory or nonce-memory read that fails during A.4
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `503 capacity_exhausted`, never `401`

conformance_cases.case: a receipt-record, directory or transport-log read that fails during a submit, or a submit lock that cannot be taken
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `503 capacity_exhausted`, no admission, no charge; never `envelope_conflict`, `contact_not_active`, `recipient_key_changed` or `insufficient_credit`

conformance_cases.case: a receipt post during which a record read or write fails
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `503 capacity_exhausted`, never `not_found`; the recipient's retry of the same bytes, while the admission is live or once the receipt committed, is recorded once and answers `200`; after a release with no receipt recorded it answers `not_found`

conformance_cases.case: a submit to a recipient the sender has blocked, or who has blocked the sender
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `403 contact_not_active`, the same status and body as the answer for a missing grant

conformance_cases.case: two concurrent submits of one logical message naming different recipients
conformance_cases.required_outcome: never both admitted; the one whose step 6 reads the other's admission is `envelope_conflict`

conformance_cases.case: a block after a delivery's first hand-out, the recipient having stored it
conformance_cases.required_outcome: the recipient's receipt is recorded and the sender reaches `recipient_stored`

conformance_cases.case: a resubmit, after its receipt was recorded, carrying a different envelope for the same device and key epoch
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `envelope_conflict`

conformance_cases.case: a resubmit, after its admission was released without a receipt, carrying a different envelope for the same device and key epoch
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `envelope_conflict`, no charge, nothing forwarded

conformance_cases.case: a step 9 record that commits but whose outcome the service cannot confirm
conformance_cases.required_outcome: `503 capacity_exhausted`, nothing forwarded, A.6.5 answers `unknown`; the client's resubmission of the same bytes is not charged again, and is admitted whenever a first submit of the same body would be, except that no credit is needed

conformance_cases.case: a re-encryption after `recipient_key_changed` and the owner's confirmation, to a replacement device whose key epoch number equals the old device's, no receipt having been recorded for the first admission; the re-encryption being one that, as a first submit, would be admitted, credit aside
conformance_cases.required_outcome: admitted, not charged again

conformance_cases.case: a poll page whose first receipt fails verification
conformance_cases.required_outcome: that message stays `pending`, the receipts after it are processed, and `receipts_after` advances past all of them
